title: LASSO DNA methylation predictor identifies C9orf72 repeat expansion carriers
summary: Genome-wide methylation arrays on 27 carriers and 250 non-carriers of the pathogenic C9orf72 expansion found eight hypermethylated CpG sites at the locus, and a LASSO predictor of carrier status reached 98.6% average accuracy. In an independent cohort of 1,589 bipolar disorder cases, 580 relatives and 289 controls, it flagged four carriers that repeat-primed PCR confirmed. Training included only 27 carriers and the validation found four, so precision at low prevalence is not established.
ai_technology: LASSO regression on DNA methylation array data to predict repeat expansion carrier status

evidence.tested: Predicted carriers in an independent array cohort were confirmed by repeat-primed PCR.
evidence.unknown: Performance with few carriers and in other cohorts and repeat loci; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A LASSO model predicted repeat expansion status from methylation data.
